jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Growth
jobs.description:
About Wealthfront
Wealthfront pioneered automated investing by offering broad access to sophisticated investing strategies at a fraction of the cost of traditional financial advisers. Since then, we’ve continued to expand the ways we help our clients build wealth through saving, investing, and home lending. From the very beginning, we’ve been a product-led growth company. We focus on building low cost, high-value, high quality experiences. These enable us to establish long-term relationships with happy clients who gladly refer their friends, family, peers, and colleagues. Our commitment to our clients and high bar for excellence set us apart from traditional financial institutions, fostering trust with our clients and empowering them to build lasting wealth on their own terms.
Product Management at Wealthfront
We earn and maintain client trust through quality product experiences built with a deep understanding of the client, close collaboration across a wide variety of functions, and high visibility with the executive team. As a result of that trust, clients stay with us for a long time and entrust us with more of their money each year. For our business, delight is the greatest form of virality. When we delight our clients, they tell others about us. We balance improving existing products with developing new products. Lastly, we are a learning-oriented organization. We care far more about achieving a high magnitude of success on a few successful products than we do about every product being successful.
Growth at Wealthfront
The Growth team balances short-term projects with fast iteration and larger initiatives, working across Wealthfront’s entire product suite. The team:
Drives high intent visitors to Wealthfront: improving signup conversion, increasing adoption of financial services, and increasing share of wallet among existing clients.
Understands and shapes the flywheels of client acquisition, activation, and referrals— building collective intelligence across the company about them.
Develops highly effective experimentation strategies that enable us to learn and see impact as efficiently as possible while honoring our trusted relationship with clients: enabling clients to improve their financial outcomes while making changes that grow the business. 
Actively tracks and responds to new information, including macroeconomic conditions, demographic shifts, technology shifts and other opportunity signals. Growth by nature is highly responsive to changing priorities. As the PM lead, you’ll be trusted to move quickly to react to new insights and product launches with high leverage opportunities.
Maintain a longer term view alongside nearterm opportunities, such that the team is aware of approaching local maxima and ready to discover the next paradigm when appropriate.

Responsibilities
-
Define and execute a product-led growth roadmap to improve business outcomes, using both quantitative and qualitative data

-
Lead a cross-functional team including engineering, design, data science, user research and marketing to define the product roadmap

-
Solicit feedback from, and create alignment with, executives

-
Partner with marketing on client acquisition and product adoption strategies across all channels, including referrals, organic, paid, and lifecycle
What we’re looking for
-
7+ years of Product Management experience, including in a product-led growth role

-
Strong strategic thinking informed by deeply understanding the business and client needs/motivations

-
Executional, action-oriented mindset with an eagle eye for detail

-
Excellent communication and presentation skills

-
Adept at driving alignment around trade-off decisions based on quickly changing product and company priorities

-
Analytical mindset and a data-driven approach to problem solving
Estimated annual salary: $238,000 - $270,000 USD, plus generous equity and a discretionary bonus.
Benefits include medical, vision, dental, 401K matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, generous time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursements, professional development, employee investing discount, and more!


About Wealthfront
 
Here at Wealthfront, our mission is to create a financial system that favors people, not institutions. We do this by leveraging technology to build powerful, low-cost, and easy-to-use financial products that help modern investors grow and manage their money.
 
We started with the ambition to transform the investment advisory business. By automating strategies typically reserved for the wealthy, we unlocked access to high quality investment advice for a digitally-native generation that was underserved by traditional institutions. Since then, we've expanded to a full suite of products designed to help our clients turn their savings into long-term wealth, including:
 
• A Cash Account that, through our partner banks, offers one of the highest annual percentage yields on uninvested cash in the industry, while providing instant and secure access to your money with no account fees and a full suite of checking features.
 
• A zero-commission Stock Investing Account with 50+ handpicked collections that help DIY investors discover new companies and make smarter investing decisions.
 
• Multiple automated investing portfolios designed to unlock tax savings through sophisticated strategies like fixed income, tax-loss harvesting, and direct indexing—which we offer at industry-leading low costs and accessible minimums.
 
Our award-winning products have attracted over 1 million clients who trust us with more than $100 billion of their hard earned savings—and we're far from done. If you’re inspired to help us reshape the financial industry as we create our next chapter, let’s talk!
 
For more information please visit www.wealthfront.com.We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
 
 
Please review our candidate privacy notice. 
 
 
Disclosures: All investing involves risk, including the possible loss of principal. Tax-Loss Harvesting benefits vary depending on the client's entire tax and investment profile. Wealthfront doesn’t provide tax advice. The Cash Account is offered by Wealthfront Brokerage LLC (“Wealthfront Brokerage”), Member of FINRA/SIPC. Wealthfront Brokerage is not a bank. We convey funds to partner banks who accept and maintain deposits, provide the variable interest rate, and provide access to FDIC pass-through insurance. Investment management and advisory services–which are not FDIC insured–are provided by Wealthfront Advisers LLC (“Wealthfront Advisers”), an SEC-registered investment adviser. The checking features offered in the Wealthfront Cash Account are provided by Green Dot Bank, Member FDIC. Fees and Eligibility requirements may apply to certain checking features, please see the Deposit Account Agreement for details.
 
 
By “award-winning products”, please refer to www.wealthfront.com/reviews for more information. Wealthfront Corporation oversees Total Client Assets and Trusted Clients through Wealthfront Advisers and Wealthfront Brokerage. Wealthfront Advisers and Wealthfront Brokerage are wholly owned subsidiaries of Wealthfront Corporation.

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing, Investing
jobs.location: Palo Alto, CA (Open to US-based Remote)
jobs.description:
Wealthfront is looking for an experienced Director of Product Marketing to lead go-to-market strategy for our Managed and Self-Directed investing business. Reporting to the VP of Marketing, you’ll help shape and build a world-class product marketing team through deep customer insights, clear product narratives, strong go-to-market operational leadership and collaboration in the product roadmap. You’ll work closely with partners across the company in Product, Design, Engineering, Creative, Research, and Data Science.
Product Marketing at Wealthfront
The product marketing team is a critical function that helps define the roadmap, identify and validate target audiences, refine positioning, and scale products after they have found product market fit. Successful product marketers at Wealthfront are able to define and validate the value and growth hypotheses for a product, are energized by iterative experimentation, excel in ambiguous environments, and are fluent with qualitative and quantitative data. They are also strong cross-functional leaders and communicators. They are highly collaborative and oriented toward product-led growth. 
Success will require strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and a customer-focused mindset. You’ll help us build and grow financial products that favor people, not institutions.

Responsibilities
-
Lead the team in crafting and executing strategies to bring new products to market, from identifying initial beachhead audiences, to developing resonant positioning and a rich learning agenda, to scaling distribution of products that find product-market fit.

-
Partner with Wealthfront’s Product team, consumer research, engineering, and design to develop a product roadmap that serves unmet needs of our customers and creates new opportunities for business growth

-
Craft focused briefs, rooted in business and customer insights, for creative teams to execute against

-
Lead business performance recaps and findings with executive leadership team

-
Be a voracious consumer of culture and help highlight trends that can inform our creative and product strategy

-
Manage an experienced product marketer, contributing to a team culture of excellence, curiosity, and respect.
Qualifications
-
8+ years in consumer product marketing or growth marketing, with technology and/or startup experience

-
Passionate storyteller with strong communication, presentation, and writing skills

-
Strategic thinker who equally values creativity and marketing effectiveness

-
Ability to bring structure to ambiguity, deploy frameworks, and distill insights into coherent, concise, and actionable plans that tackle complex objectives

-
A data-driven mindset and comfort with analysis, testing, and measurement methodologies. Experience running messaging tests and A/B experiments.

-
A low-ego leader with a willingness to get into the details and a tendency to make others around them successful

-
Experience managing and developing a team of marketers

-
Personal finance knowledge and experience is a big bonus, but not required

-
Bachelor's degree or higher
Estimated annual salary range: $225,000-$250,000 USD plus Equity.
Plus comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), generous time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursements, professional development, an employee investing discount, and more!
